[[NIT Season Tip-Off]] champions |bowl= [[2014 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result= Elite Eight }} {{2013–14 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2013–14 [[Arizona Wildcats]] men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Arizona]] during the [[2013–14 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by fifth-year head coach [[Sean Miller]] and played home games at [[McKale Center]] in [[Tucson, Arizona]] as a member of the [[Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 33–5, 15–3 in Pac-12 play and won their first Pac-12 regular season championship since 2011 (the 13th time overall). They advanced to the championship game of the [[2014 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] where they lost to UCLA. They received an at-large bid to the [[2014 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2013–14 Weber State Wildcats men's basketball team|Weber State]], [[2013–14 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]], and [[2013–14 San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball team|San Diego State]] to advance to the Elite Eight where they lost to [[2013–14 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team|Wisconsin]]. ==Previous season== Arizona's [[2012–13 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|2012–13 team]] finished with a record of 27–8 after advancing to the [[2013 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]'s Sweet Sixteen. The team went 12–6 in the [[2012–13 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 regular season]], putting them in a three-way tie for second place. In the [[2013 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]], the team defeated [[2012-13 Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball team|Colorado]] to advance to the semifinals, where they lost to [[2012–13 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|UCLA]]. Ranked 21st in the post-season AP poll, the Cats were seeded 6th in the West Region of the [[2013 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. Arizona won its first two tournament games, defeating 11-seed [[2012–13 Belmont Bruins men's basketball team|Belmont]] and 14-seed [[2012–13 Harvard Crimson men's basketball team|Harvard]], before falling to 2-seed [[2012–13 Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball team|Ohio State]] in the regional semifinals.{{cite web |url=http://grfx.cstv.com/photos/schools/ariz/sports/m-baskbl/auto_pdf/2012-13/stats/season_stats_final.pdf |title=2012‐13 University of Arizona Basketball Season Stats |publisher=The University of Arizona - Official Athletics Website |date=March 29, 2013 |access-date=March 30, 2013 |archive-date=January 27, 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130127012348/http://grfx.cstv.com/photos/schools/ariz/sports/m-baskbl/auto_pdf/2012-13/stats/season_stats_final.pdf |url-status=dead }} ==Off-season== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
